# Direct seed with primitive inputs

This owned fixture passes one method-owned Object formal and two independent
boolean values to a public instance method with a fixed nominal result. Two
plain ancestors lead to a closed generic base and marker. A static generic
forwarder retains receiver evaluation and original virtual dispatch.

Four frozen routes run 96 fresh cases twice with both source and SDK declarations.
They observe each boolean, the seed and receiver identities, dynamic overrides,
opaque and aliased returns, nulls, partial effects, delayed casts and exact checked,
runtime and error identities. Nine wrong programs and eight Code-preserving
Signature controls qualify the observations. Every emitted source is compiled;
all class and method definitions, roles, Signature and Exceptions are compared.

All names and inputs are independently owned examples.
